## Contributor checklist

- [ ] Every factual claim is **linked to a real source**, or explicitly marked `> ⚠️ needs verification`.
- [ ] No invented facts, statistics, or citations.
- [ ] Time-sensitive claims are **dated** (e.g. "As of 2026‑08, …").
- [ ] Tone is **neutral** — demonstrated vs. plausible vs. anecdotal is distinguished; no hype.
- [ ] Content is **extractable** — clear headings, self-contained sections, tables/lists where useful.
- [ ] New terms are defined on first use and/or added to the [glossary](../docs/09-glossary.md).
- [ ] Links are valid and prefer canonical/stable URLs.
- [ ] I agree to license this contribution under **CC BY‑SA 4.0**.
